name: Planner Agent
description: Analyzes a task and produces an execution plan. Reads the project structure, conventions, and relevant code to decompose a task into ordered subtasks. Each subtask has a clear action, target file, and expected outcome.

inputs.name: Task Description
inputs.description: Natural language task to plan (e.g., 'Add email validation to the registration form')

inputs.name: Pre-built Context
inputs.description: Optional pre-built context from context-builder (saves one agent iteration)
